input.summary: The public TypeScript option type for the graph series' `nodeScaleRatio` is declared as the literal `0.6` instead of `number`, so any other numeric value (e.g. `nodeScaleRatio: 0.8`) is a compile error for library users even though the runtime accepts any number. Widen the declared type to `number`. No runtime/default change.
steps:
src/chart/graph/GraphSeries.ts — in `export interface GraphSeriesOption` (declared at line 141), line 174 currently reads:
```ts
    /**
     * Symbol size scale ratio in roam
     */
    nodeScaleRatio?: 0.6,
```
The type annotation `0.6` is a numeric literal type (almost certainly a copy/paste of the default value into the type position). Replace line 174 with:
```ts
    nodeScaleRatio?: number,
```
Keep the JSDoc comment on lines 171-173 untouched. Minimal-diff option is to keep the existing trailing comma as shown; dropping it (`nodeScaleRatio?: number`) is also valid and matches the surrounding members of this interface, which use no delimiter, and matches the analogous declaration in src/chart/tree/TreeSeries.ts:98 (`nodeScaleRatio?: number`). Either compiles and passes lint (no `member-delimiter-style` rule is configured in /workspace/.eslintrc-common.yaml).

DO NOT change the runtime default: src/chart/graph/GraphSeries.ts:477 inside `static defaultOption: GraphSeriesOption = {` (line 416) must stay `nodeScaleRatio: 0.6,` (with the preceding comment `// Symbol size scale ratio in roam` on line 476). It still type-checks after the widening since `0.6` is assignable to `number`.

DO NOT change the consumer: src/chart/graph/graphHelper.ts:30-35 reads `const nodeScaleRatio = seriesModel.option.nodeScaleRatio;` and computes `const nodeScale = (roamZoom - 1) * nodeScaleRatio + 1;`. This keeps compiling unchanged (tsconfig.json has no `strictNullChecks`, so the `| undefined` from the optional property is not an issue — same as before the change). Callers of `getNodeGlobalScale` in src/chart/graph/GraphView.ts:129, 346, 357, 369 and src/chart/graph/circularLayoutHelper.ts:154 are unaffected.

No other file needs editing. `GraphSeriesOption` is re-exported publicly via src/export/option.ts:76 and :194 (`export type GraphSeriesOption = GraphSeriesOptionInner & SeriesInjectedOption;`) and listed in the `SeriesOption` map at src/export/option.ts:233, so widening the source interface automatically fixes the emitted `.d.ts`/public typing — no separate declaration file to update (there is no checked-in /workspace/types or index.d.ts with this member; `types/` is generated by `npm run build:lib`).

Verify: run `npx tsc --noEmit` (npm script `checktype`) from /workspace — must pass. Optionally `npx eslint src/chart/graph/GraphSeries.ts`. Optionally, to prove the acceptance signal, temporarily add to test/types/basic.ts a graph series with `nodeScaleRatio: 0.8` and run `npm run test:dts` (build/testDts.js compiles test/types/*.ts against the generated types with `strict: true`); before the fix that line errors with `Type '0.8' is not assignable to type '0.6'`, after the fix it compiles. Only keep such a test edit if the task wants test coverage — no existing unit test in /workspace/test/ut/spec covers graph `nodeScaleRatio` (grep shows zero hits outside src/ and the doc-derived fixtures test/data/option-view.json, option-view2.json, ec-option-doc-statistics-201604.json, which are static data and must not be edited).
input.risks: Very low risk; single-line type-only change with no runtime effect. Two minor judgement calls: (1) whether to keep the trailing comma on the member (kept = smallest diff; removed = consistent with the rest of the interface and with TreeSeries.ts:98) — both compile and lint clean; (2) do not "fix" the default at GraphSeries.ts:477 to `number` semantics — 0.6 remains the documented default. No other requirement in /workspace/requirements touches src/chart/graph/GraphSeries.ts, so no conflict is expected.
